name.en: National Development Fund — Angel Investment Program
name.local: 國家發展基金 創業天使投資方案

check_size.raw: up to NT$20M co-investment per startup

strategy.thesis: Taiwan government co-investment vehicle that matches angels and institutions in early-stage startups (founded <8 years, capital <NT$100M) with up to NT$20M per startup; sector-agnostic but has backed PropTech ventures such as JGB Smart Property, making public capital available to real-estate-tech founders.

investment.raw: up to NT$20,000,000 co-investment per startup

program.eligibility: Taiwan-registered startups established ≤8 years with registered capital ≤NT$100M

notable_investments.company: JGB Smart Property (箍棒智慧物業)

application.how_to_apply: Apply via the NDF Angel Investment Program portal (angelinvestment.org.tw)

summary.en: Taiwan's National Development Fund Angel Investment Program (NT$10bn allocation) co-invests up to NT$20M per early-stage startup (≤8 yrs old, ≤NT$100M capital); sector-agnostic but has co-invested in PropTech startup JGB Smart Property, channeling public capital into real-estate tech.
summary.local: 台灣國發基金創業天使投資方案（規模新台幣 100 億元），對成立未滿 8 年、資本額 1 億元以下的早期新創最高共同投資 2,000 萬元；不限產業，並曾共同投資房地產科技新創 JGB Smart Property。

sources.title: 申請投資金額新臺幣2仟萬元以下(創業天使投資方案)
sources.publisher: 國家發展基金管理會 (National Development Fund)
sources.supports: NT$10bn allocation, ≤8yr / ≤NT$100M eligibility, up to NT$20M co-investment
sources.quote: the Angel Investment Program allocates NT$10 billion ... For startups that have been established for no more than 8 years with registered capital not exceeding NT$100 million, the fund can provide co-investment with angel investors of up to NT$20 million per startup.

sources.title: JGB Smart Property 完成Pre-A輪募資
sources.supports: National Development Fund participated in PropTech startup JGB's Pre-A round
sources.quote: Participating Investors: 國發基金 (National Development Fund)

verification_notes: Sector-agnostic public co-investment program, not a proptech-dedicated vehicle; included because it co-invested in PropTech startup JGB Smart Property, making it a real source of capital for Taiwan real-estate tech. NT$10bn is the program-wide allocation, not a proptech-specific budget. Program founding year not stated in fetched sources (left null).
